description.value: Village-operated campground in Slocan with creekside forested tent sites and coin-op showers, steps from the Slocan Valley Rail Trail and Slocan Lake beach; open May 1 to October 15.

address.value: 1020 Giffin Avenue, PO Box 50, Slocan, BC V0G 2C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a municipally operated campground (Village of Slocan) with 35 sites including creek-side tenting sites in a forested area. Services explicitly listed include coin-op showers, free WiFi, water (at hookup sites), sani-dump, and firewood. An online reservation system is confirmed for 2026. The website mentions proximity to the Slocan Valley Rail Trail and hiking/biking trails. The campground is seasonal (May 1–Oct 15) and today (May 26, 2026) falls within the operating season, so it should be open. The OSM community is listed as Winlaw, but the campground is clearly in the Village of Slocan at 1020 Giffin Avenue.
concerns: OSM community is listed as Winlaw but the campground is located in the Village of Slocan at 1020 Giffin Avenue, Slocan, BC
OSM has no phone or address; website provides phone (250) 355-2266 seasonal, (250) 355-2277 off-season, and address 1020 Giffin Avenue, Slocan
Website page title uses 'Slocan RV Park & Campground' while the body and OSM use 'Springer Creek RV Park & Campground'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established municipal campground with tenting sites directly adjacent to the Slocan Valley Rail Trail, offering showers, WiFi, and online reservations — a strong fit for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email for campground: campground@villageofslocan.ca. Toll-free number also available: (866) 355-2023. Seasonal operation May 1 to October 15. Operated by the Village of Slocan.

wow_evidence: directly adjacent to the Slocan Valley Rail Trail, offering showers, WiFi
